records.title: Enhanced XIAO battery sensing
records.text: This setting enables an external ADC divider, not the battery charger. Default sense pin is D0/GPIO1. With correctly installed divider: set battery.connected on. Inspect with get battery.connected, get battery.gpio and get adc.multiplier. Disable before changing the pin; set battery.gpio default selects D0. Default divider multiplier is 2.000. Use the exact board wiring guide and confirm the midpoint voltage before connection.

records.title: Enhanced XIAO DHT11 module
records.text: For the supported 3-pin DHT11 module on this XIAO repeater/room: signal D1/GPIO2, supply 3V3, common GND. Disconnect power before wiring. Admin console: set environment.sensor none; set environment.gpio 2; set environment.sensor dht11. Wait at least 2 seconds, then get environment. Check module pin labels and the source guide; this does not describe bare 4-pin sensor wiring.

records.title: Enhanced ESP32 repeater power-saving commands
records.text: Authenticated repeater console: powersaving on. Inspect with powersaving, disable with powersaving off. ESP32 sleep becomes eligible after 2 minutes of uptime. LoRa remains listening. Native USB can become unavailable during sleep. These commands are console guidance; requesting this guide does not change a device setting.
